result: Audit done: 1,008 of 1,474 items flagged, 554 without a measurement; the 4096-key scan causes about 34,700 of 36,026 instructions per pthread_create+join; the start-up data budget charges a page no process faults
head: 87b60f1a6

gate.affected: no product change: clippy and static on the role (decision-evidence-audit-lint)

rulings.item: Static TLS surplus 64 KiB (R14-4, D-22.6): the record says sized by tunable, the code is a const and glibc.rtld.optional_static_tls is unused; a reused thread stack zeroes the surplus every time
rulings.recommendation: the reference's default surplus, honour optional_static_tls for the rare case (with #8009), and correct D-22.6

informational: THREAD-CREATE-COST cause: KeyTable::span scans 4096 key words at every cached-stack reuse and thread exit (about 34,700 of 36,026 instructions per create+join, perf annotate); proposal: a high-water mark, then a 1,024-entry key area with growth
D-X.138 start-up data budget charges the RESERVE_MEM .lbss page; probe 3 measured 0 faults in it (static release)
Rulings file: RPC 4 MiB record cap (#1466) is moot (RPC stubs, D-29.5); #1317 __libc_freeres is already reversed but still under the provisional heading
Dynamic one-fopen program: 201,021 vs 138,655 user instructions and 76 vs 57 faults; not linked to any assumption by this audit

impact.what: audit only: no decision, product or test changed
pthread_create+join user instructions per pair if the key scan goes (projection from the profile)
THREAD-CREATE-COST (cause found), #8009 static TLS surplus (two more facts)

improvement: A record whose text claims a mechanism (D-22.6: sized by tunable) should be checked against the code by a static check; the filter could flag records naming a tunable that config.rs parses but nothing reads
next_step: Brief a story for the key-scan watermark (measure on the create+join percall row); give finding 2 to #8009; check the start-up data budget members by fault address on both profiles
